title: The third or fourth time updating the website styling & the future of EFC
metadesc: the hopefully finalised style of the website & the future of EFC
content:
As the title suggests, and as one keen-eyed person may have noticed, the website underwent another style change, though this should be the last one for a good while because this gets tiring.
As for the future of Engine Fan Club, all games that were developed on roblox since the move will no longer receive any more updates at all. It is essentially a fresh start.
So what's next? Currently the active project is rpgthing which is planned to release first with basic functionality and one (1) dungeon to get the feel of the balancing. After the initial release, 'rpgthing' will become a separate thing that'll get content updates every so often.
Lastly, some extra content related to the games (mainly related to Mustard currently). These are just for fun and should not be treated with the highest utmost expectations (this goes for release times too if unfinished).

personal roadmap & TLDR (in no particular order)

  • website finishing touches
  • rpgthing v1.0.0 release
  • some extra mustard content
  • possible secondary, smaller 3D game
That's all, folks!

title: Moving from Roblox to Godot & a second website overhaul
metadesc: Finally working on updating the Engine Fan Club website
content:
After deciding to move on from Roblox onto Godot for all future games, the website had to be updated to reflect the change since the older 'active' games will not be translated to Roblox for several reasons. The old posts will be kept for archival and to remind myself.

Additionally, the mustard skill creator won't be more easily accessible for an indefinite amount of time because that'll be replaced by an actual game to test things out more hands-on with a working 'mustard' engine.

title: Updating the Mustard Skill Creator
metadesc: finally updating the now-outdated mustard skill creator and including it on the efc website
content:
The mustard skill creator was long overdue for a makeover and some improvements. Not only is it now included in engine fan club, it's also got a new face. This is a small update because I have the basic functionality and test units working for it, with the saving/loading of custom set characters coming soon. It will also come with support for importing characters from the older version into this new version so that you don't have to use both websites.
The creator will be finalised in the upcoming days, it's only out now so I can test if it works for everyone.
Mobile accessibility for the skill creator will not be implemented for a good while if ever.
